instruction: Run the calculator, verify button layout and keyboard-independent interaction, and test basic operations, chained calculations, decimals, clear/backspace, invalid input, and division by zero.

details: calculator.py exposes a Tkinter button grid with C, backspace, division, multiplication, digits, subtraction, addition, equals, zero, and decimal controls.
Button commands call the same handlers as keyboard input, so core interaction is keyboard-independent.
Safe AST evaluation supports addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, unary plus/minus, decimals, and chained expressions.
Clear resets the expression; backspace removes the last character; invalid/incomplete expressions show an Error message; division by zero is rejected with a specific error.
The repository provides assertions for precedence, unary/decimal arithmetic, formatting, and division-by-zero handling.
verification.limitation: No GUI/display execution environment was available, so visual rendering and click events were verified by source inspection rather than live interaction.
